title: AnimationNodeExtension uses 32 bit float array but time is 64 bit float
body:
### Tested versions

- Found in master (4.6) https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/7ed0b6167618f9c8c5df87c7e83da6003c081368
- Expected to be failing in 4.5 release


### System information

Macos Tahoe 26.1

### Issue description

https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_animationnodeextension.html

We noticed in an animation team code review that time is 64bit in the animation system however AnimationNodeExtension uses a Packed 32 bit float array.

See also: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/11123

Logging this so we don't forget. We are unable to determine how prevalent often this bug occurs  by user-developers.

We don't want to solve imaginary problems so if anyone has this problem please post a reply.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Theoretically we could load a animation clip that exceeded 32 bit float precision of time.
1. Typically this would appear as stuttering of the animation.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

So far it is theoretical, however I would assume we could make a 100 day animation we seek a few minutes from the end and see what breaks.
